evidencePassages.text: Note: Self-declaration accepted. Giftor is father of client, UK resident, retired. No documentary evidence obtained.

detail: A £200,000 gift from the donor (the client's father) was accepted on self-declaration alone. The firm's own policy §4.3.1 requires documentary evidence for any gift exceeding £10,000. All six evidence items on the donor's source of funds form are marked 'Not obtained'.
reference: CLC AML Guidance, Procedure §20 (Source of Funds)
